newsitem.title: UK: Tate & Lyle raises U.S. maltodextrin output.
newsitem.headline: Tate & Lyle raises U.S. maltodextrin output.

text.p: British food products group Tate and Lyle Plc said on Tuesday its U.S. subsidiary A E Staley Manufacturing Company would raise production of its corn-based maltodextrin products.
It said production capacity would be raised by 100 million pounds at Staley's plant in Loudon, Tennessee, with effect from autumn 1997.
The company said maltodextrins were used in a variety of foods including dry soup mixes, confectionery, frostings, desserts, salad dressings and sports drinks.
